name: prompts
source: program demo; var a,b:integer; begin write('First: '); read(a); readln; write('Second: '); readln(b); writeln(a+b) end.

name: recursive
source: program demo; function sum(depth:integer):integer; var n:integer; begin readln(n); if depth=0 then sum:=n else sum:=n+sum(depth-1) end; begin writeln(sum(2)) end.

name: heap_capture
source: program demo; type P=^Node; Node=record n:integer end; var p1:P; procedure outer(var n:integer); procedure inner; begin readln(n) end; begin inner end; begin new(p1); outer(p1^.n); writeln(p1^.n); dispose(p1) end.

name: borrow_once
source: program demo; type P=^Node; Node=record n:integer end; var p1:P; calls:integer; function get:P; begin calls:=calls+1; exit(p1) end; begin calls:=0; new(p1); read(get()^.n); writeln(calls,':',p1^.n); dispose(p1) end.

name: character_view
source: program demo; var s:string[8]; procedure take(var c:char); begin read(c); readln end; begin s:='ab'; take(s[2]); writeln(s) end.

name: mixed_values
source: program demo; var n:integer; r:real; c:char; s:string[16]; begin read(n,r,c,s); readln; writeln(n,':',r,':',ord(c),':',s) end.

name: empty_line
source: program demo; var s:string; begin write('Empty: '); readln(s); writeln(length(s)) end.

name: safe_text
source: program demo; var s:string; begin write(''); readln(s); writeln(s) end.

name: eof
source: program demo; var n:integer; begin write('Number: '); readln(n) end.

name: invalid
source: program demo; var n:integer; begin readln(n) end.

name: capacity
source: program demo; var s:string[1]; begin read(s) end.

name: nil_before_wait
source: program demo; type P=^integer; var p1:P; begin p1:=nil; read(p1^) end.

name: invalid_unicode
source: program demo; var c:char; begin read(c) end.

name: line_end_eof
source: program demo; var c:char; begin read(c,c,c) end.

name: guard_before_wait
source: program demo; var n:integer; procedure p(var a,b:integer); begin for a:=1 to 2 do read(b) end; begin p(n,n) end.

name: formatted_real
source: program p; var r:real; begin write('Real: '); readln(r); writeln(r:8:2) end.

name: random_values
source: program p; var bound,i,n:integer; ok:boolean; begin randomize; write('Bound: '); readln(bound); ok:=true; for i:=1 to 100 do begin n:=random(bound); ok:=ok and (n>=0) and (n<bound) end; writeln(ok) end.

name: enumeration_storage
source: program p; type Day=(Mon,Tue,Wed); var d:Day; a:array[Day] of integer; begin d:=Tue; write(d,': '); readln(a[d]); inc(d); writeln(d,': ',a[Tue]) end.

name: set_storage
source: program p; type Values=set of 0..10; var a:Values; n:integer; begin a:=[1,3]; write('Member: '); readln(n); writeln(n in a); a:=a+[n]; write('Next: '); readln(n); writeln(n in a,a=[1..3]) end.
